independence_evidence: The publisher's about page says the magazine is 'an independent print publication' created by two founders, 'not backed by big investors' and entirely self-funded (https://www.wearemakers.shop/pages/about-us-1); the EU compliance page names the company as We Are Makers Global LTD.
qualifies_reason: A self-funded independent print quarterly that has published Editions Thirteen to Twenty between January 2025 and November 2026, the latest on sale now in the publisher's own shop.
what_it_is: We Are Makers is a print magazine about craftspeople and artists around the world, built from studio and workshop visits, long interviews and documentary photography. Each edition profiles a dozen or so makers across disciplines such as ceramics, furniture, textiles and metalwork, concentrating on how they live and work rather than on instructions or projects. It is for readers interested in craft, making and small creative businesses.
